name: google-news
description: Search Google News, get top stories and read articles. No API key or headless browser.
long_description: Gives Claude live news from Google News. Search for articles on any keyword with a timeframe, language and country, read the current top stories for any region or topic, and pull the readable text of an article. Results link to the real publisher URL rather than a Google redirect. Built on the open source google-news-scraper library.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search Google News directly for articles on any keyword, company, person, team or topic. Free, no API key.

tools.name: top_stories
tools.description: Get the current Google News top stories for a country and language, or a topic page.

tools.name: get_article_text
tools.description: Fetch an article URL and return its readable body text, title, byline and publish time.
